newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 10.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The Shanghai Stock Exchange says it will strengthen supervision over the reporting of 1997 interim results of firms listed on the bourse to ensure accurate data is offered to investors.
- Two more Chinese state-run companies will be listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange later this month, bringing the total number of China's state firms listed in Hong Kong to 27.
- Financial experts have proposed establishing Sino-foreign mutual funds for investment in the stock and debt markets.

- BUSINESS NEWS - More Shanghai residents are using mortgage loans to buy homes with personal property loans by the Construction Bank's Shanghai branch hitting 880 million yuan in the first five month of this year, a year-on-year rise of 125.8 percent.
